描述_EN: 2016’. the stadium for the 2020 olympic games undoubtedly will become kuma’s most well-known work. kengo kuma (b.1954) is a leading japanese architect of works mainly in japan and china. the architect has titled, signed and dated the drawing ‘olympic stadium 2020 / kengo kuma – mar 27. at the moment, he is completing the building of v&a dundee. he made this drawing especially for the v&a upon a request for a drawing in his own hand. it is a fine quick sketch showing the elevation of the stadium, the horizontal rings executed in thick black crayon and the vertical zig-zag forms of the uprights in pencil. the support is a cream textured japanese paper.
描述_ZN: 2016'. 2020年奥运会的体育场馆无疑将成为隈研吾最知名的作品。 Kengo kuma (b.1954) 是日本著名的建筑师，作品主要在日本和中国。 建筑师在这幅画上有标题、签名和日期 "2020年奥林匹克体育场/Kengo kuma - Mar 27. 目前，他正在完成V&A Dundee的建筑。 他为V&A特别制作了这幅画，是应要求用自己的手画的。 这是一张精细的快速草图，显示了体育场的立面，水平环形用厚厚的黑色蜡笔画出，垂直的人字形的立柱用铅笔画出。 支撑物是一张乳白色纹理的日本纸。
